root_cause: The original observer only flagged native cleanup/readback step failures. Cleanup could succeed while history deferrals (19 in native run 41546047078) or an absent/malformed runtime action artifact were not emitted to canonical Brain as registered incidents; status appeared JANITOR_STEPS_VERIFIED_SAME_RUN without actionable reporting.
repair: Classify history deferrals and absent/malformed action artifacts as report-required independently of step success. The existing original Janitor observer writes exactly one run-attempt idempotent incident comment and existing brain_observe_failure occurrence; source issue and Brain occurrence readbacks must both be proven. Missing authority or failed readback fails the original job, not cosmetic green. No parallel event store, workflow or scheduler.
prevention_rule: No GREEN or PROVEN from step result alone; every instrumented operational signal or missing signal must be detected and have durable issue+Brain readback, owned repair, regression, next natural-run check and recurrence tracking. Reporter failure is itself a failing operation.

invariants: 19 historical history-deferrals cannot remain silently classified as clean native success
missing action artifact is never empty array success
same-run cleanup success does not imply global green
failed observer Brain RPC fails original job
semantic incident fingerprint and run-attempt idempotency
no second scheduler or weakened security gates
